answer: Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. A willow of per-task receipts records who did what, and the lotus of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, expired if not renewed by fresh work, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. What survives to the karst is a record of labour, not a list of addresses.
